title: Show bounded shared source identity in evaluation recovery diagnostics
outcome: Show bounded shared source identity in evaluation recovery diagnostics
acceptance: Shared deciding-observation and source-recovery output describes the recorded source with a bounded SourceIdSummary instead of saying its revision is missing; existing legacy fields and decisions remain unchanged.
